restaurant.name: Kaffeine
restaurant.priceNote: Food prices are from Kaffeine's published menu. Drink and side prices are placeholders: the published menu does not list them.

values.label: Whole
values.heard: whole, regular, normal, dairy or cow's milk

values.label: Regular
values.heard: regular, small, normal or medium size

values.label: Standard
values.heard: the normal number of espresso shots

values.label: Extra shot
values.heard: an extra shot, double shot, or stronger

items.name: Poached Eggs
items.description: Poached Cacklebean eggs, hollandaise, Wildfarmed sourdough toast
items.heard: Poached eggs on sourdough toast with hollandaise. Also ordered as 'the poached eggs', 'eggs on toast' or just 'eggs'.

items.name: Avo Smash
items.description: Smashed avocado, lime, green sriracha, feta, pine nuts, chilli oil, sourdough
items.heard: Avo Smash: the smashed avocado on toast main dish, only when the guest says 'avo smash', 'avocado toast' or 'avo on toast'. Not when they say 'add avocado', 'some avocado' or 'a side of avocado'.

items.name: Eggs Florentine
items.description: Poached eggs, sautéed spinach, hollandaise, toasted English muffins
items.heard: Eggs Florentine: poached eggs with spinach on English muffins.

items.name: Eggs Benedict
items.description: Poached eggs, espresso maple syrup ham, hollandaise, English muffins
items.heard: Eggs Benedict: poached eggs with ham on English muffins. Also ordered as 'eggs benny'.

items.name: Eggs Royale
items.description: Poached eggs, smoked salmon, hollandaise, toasted English muffins
items.heard: Eggs Royale: poached eggs with smoked salmon on English muffins.

items.name: Drunken Mushrooms
items.description: Wild mushrooms, cream, garlic, thyme & white wine sauce, parmesan, sourdough
items.heard: Drunken mushrooms: wild mushrooms in white wine sauce on toast. Also ordered as 'mushrooms on toast'.

items.name: Espresso Pancakes
items.description: Kaffeine espresso syrup, mascarpone cream, fresh berries
items.heard: Espresso pancakes with mascarpone and berries. Also ordered as 'pancakes'.

items.name: Bacon & Egg Brioche
items.description: Crispy bacon, fried egg, plum tomato, avocado, aioli, rocket
items.heard: Brioche bun with crispy bacon and fried egg. Also ordered as 'bacon and egg roll', 'bacon sandwich', 'breakfast bun' or 'bacon brioche'.

items.name: Feta & Egg Brioche
items.description: Fried egg, plum tomato, feta, avocado, aioli, baby spinach
items.heard: Vegetarian brioche bun with fried egg, feta and avocado. Also ordered as 'veggie brioche' or 'egg and feta roll'.

items.name: Paleo Granola
items.heard: Paleo granola with Greek yoghurt and raspberry compote. Also ordered as 'granola', 'granola bowl' or 'yoghurt and granola'.

items.name: Seasonal Fruit Salad
items.heard: Seasonal fruit salad. Also ordered as 'fruit', 'fruit bowl' or 'fruit cup'.

items.name: Sourdough Toast
items.description: Wildfarmed sourdough, Estate Dairy cultured butter, choice of spreads
items.heard: Plain sourdough toast with butter and spreads, ordered on its own as 'toast' or 'toast and butter'.

items.name: Goat's Curd Salad
items.description: Roasted honey sprouts, beetroot, toasted walnuts, balsamic glaze, rocket
items.heard: Goat's curd and beetroot salad. Also ordered as 'the goat cheese salad', 'beetroot salad' or 'the veggie salad'.

items.name: Griddled Steak Salad
items.description: Blackened sweet corn, avocado, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella, green pesto
items.heard: Griddled steak salad with sweet corn and avocado. Also ordered as 'the steak salad' or 'beef salad'.

items.name: Pork Belly Sausage Roll
items.description: Pork belly, onion, garlic, chilli, apple
items.heard: Pork belly sausage roll. Also ordered as 'sausage roll'.

items.name: Butter Croissant
items.description: French butter croissant by Seven Seeded Bakery
items.heard: Plain French butter croissant. Ordered as 'a croissant' or 'plain croissant'. Not the almond croissant.

items.name: Almond Croissant
items.heard: Almond croissant.

items.name: Pain au Chocolat
items.heard: Pain au chocolat. Also ordered as 'chocolate croissant'.

items.name: Banana Bread
items.heard: Banana bread. Also ordered as 'banana loaf' or 'banana cake'.

items.name: Mini Chocolate Brownie
items.heard: Mini chocolate brownie, gluten free. Ordered as 'a brownie'.

items.name: Portuguese Tart
items.heard: Portuguese custard tart. Also ordered as 'pastel de nata' or 'custard tart'.

items.name: Streaky Bacon
items.heard: A side or extra of streaky bacon. Ordered as 'bacon', 'some bacon', 'a side of bacon' or 'add bacon'.

items.name: Smashed Avocado
items.heard: A side or extra of smashed avocado. Ordered as 'avocado', 'some avo', 'a side of avocado' or 'add avocado'. Not the Avo Smash main dish.

items.name: Extra Poached Egg
items.heard: One extra poached egg as a side, only when the guest explicitly says 'an extra egg', 'add an egg' or 'another egg'. Not the Poached Eggs main dish, and not any other side.

items.name: Smoked Salmon
items.heard: A side or extra of smoked salmon. Ordered as 'salmon', 'some smoked salmon' or 'add salmon'.

items.name: Espresso
items.heard: Espresso served on its own as a drink: 'an espresso' or 'a short black'. Not an extra shot added to another drink such as a latte.

items.name: Long Black
items.heard: Long black or americano: black coffee made with espresso and water. Also ordered as 'black coffee' or 'americano'.

items.name: Flat White
items.heard: Flat white. Also what a guest gets when they just say 'a coffee' or 'a white coffee' without naming a type.

items.name: Latte
items.heard: Latte or caffe latte, hot or iced. Also ordered as 'iced latte' or 'milky coffee'.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Espresso, steamed milk, foam, chocolate dust
items.heard: Cappuccino.

items.name: Mocha
items.heard: Mocha: chocolate coffee.

items.name: Batch Filter
items.heard: Batch brew filter coffee, only when the guest says the word 'filter', 'batch' or 'drip'. Not when they just say 'a coffee'.

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.heard: Hot chocolate. Also ordered as 'hot cocoa'.

items.name: English Breakfast Tea
items.heard: A pot of English breakfast tea. Ordered as 'tea', 'a cup of tea' or 'breakfast tea'.

items.name: Fresh Orange Juice
items.heard: Freshly squeezed orange juice. Ordered as 'orange juice', 'OJ' or 'a juice'.
